<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2516-05-39"><milestone unit="section" n="ca2_sbyor ba bshad pa|"/>
     <lb n="66b2"/> sbyor ba dngos la grangs dang ming gi dbye ba bstan pa ni sbyor ba yang nas so || 
    so so'i mtshan nyid nyi shu las yul gyis phye ba lnga'i dang po
     <note type="gloss">°u°°'di rnaMs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA chen po</rs>s dang po rtogs dka' ba gyur ba las mdo dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">'grel</rs> par bltas shing go mi chen po la dris pas gsungs pa shin tu legs pa ste gzhan ni gzhung las kyang don gyi thugs la dri ba'i rna chung gsungs zhes</note> 
     blta ba'i spyod yul la mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i don ni ko'u shi ka 'di la nas te | shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni rnam pa ma lus pa spros pa <note type="gloss">bdag 2 dang yod med la sogs pa'i</note> zhi bar sgom pa'i sbyor ba'o |</seg></TEI>
